reviews.author: GIRISH JOSHI
reviews.text: The 9th Mile Dhaba is a part of Royal Orchids Hotel. The dhaba is under a temporary canopy. Tables are spaced correctly. The staff is cordial. I am a Vegetarian, I found the menu a restrictive. Starters were good, Dahi ke Tikki was excellent, however Paneer aam ki Nikki was not great. Dal Makhani was superb. Cocktails need an improvement in taste. Live music improved the experience. Per person the cost worked out to be Rs 1500, according to my perception this is a bit on the higher side for the ambience, the food platter, quantitiy and the taste. I would rate this overall as satisfactory!
